title: Ahijah's Message to Jeroboam's Wife
description: Jeroboam sent his wife in disguise to the blind prophet Ahijah at Shiloh to learn what would happen to their sick son Abijah. Ahijah saw through her disguise and proclaimed the Lord's harsh judgment against Jeroboam's royal house: the boy would die as soon as she returned home, and the entire family would be wiped out. When she stepped across the threshold at Tirzah, the boy died.
